name: Vampire Cutthroat
oracle_text:
Skulk (This creature can't be blocked by creatures with greater power.)
Lifelink (Damage dealt by this creature also causes you to gain that much life.)
blocked_sentences: Skulk (This creature can't be blocked by creatures with greater power.)

needs.what: The same missing capability filed for `stromkirk_noble`: a static continuous effect that vetoes a block declaration against its source, filtered by a characteristic of the would-be blocker, consulted from `engine/combat.py:can_block` when blockers are declared. Skulk needs a *distinct sub-need* on top of that: the filter is not a fixed quality but a RELATIVE COMPARISON between two objects -- "power of the would-be blocker > power of this creature", read from derived (not printed) power on both sides at the moment blockers are declared, so an anthem, a pump spell or a +1/+1 counter on either creature changes who may block. Concretely this wants either (a) a `skulk` entry in `Keyword`/`EVASION_KEYWORDS` handled directly in `can_block`, or (b) a general "can't be blocked by" static whose filter may express a comparison against a characteristic of the source -- e.g. a value expression like `{"power_of": "source"}` usable as the right-hand side of the selector's `power: {"op": ">", "value": ...}` comparison.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `Keyword` is a closed enum of fifteen (`src/automtg/engine/enums.py:131`) with no `skulk`, and `EVASION_KEYWORDS` is `frozenset({FLYING, MENACE})` -- an unknown keyword is a load-time `DslError`, not a silently inert card. `can_block` (`src/automtg/engine/combat.py:121-153`) consults exactly three restrictions: protection, flying-vs-reach, and (via `blocks_valid`) menace; nothing reads a static there. `STATIC_EFFECTS` (`src/automtg/cards/loader.py:41-71`) offers `buff`, `grant_keyword`, `set_pt`, `add_subtype`, `set_types`, `protection` and the player-wide ones -- every object-facing one changes a characteristic, none constrains block legality. `protection` is the only static `can_block` does read, but it is wrong twice over: it names a fixed quality (`from_types`/`from_subtypes`/`from_colors`) and cannot express a power comparison at all, and it is a DEBT keyword that would also stop damage, enchanting and targeting, making the creature far better than the one printed. `menace` restricts blocker *count*, not blocker power. Filter keys cannot reach it either: `STATIC_FILTER_KEYS` (`loader.py:76-97`) has no `power` key whatsoever, and even the full selector's `power: {"op": ">", "value": {...}}` compares against a value expression with no way to name the blocked creature's own power -- `power_of` takes a `var` (snapshot) or a `target`, and a static block restriction has neither. Static filters are additionally required to read only *printed* characteristics, which skulk must not do.
